title: Reading
summary: The agent can read the app's data, with SQL or read tools that can't write.
description: The app's data is its SQLite database, and whatever the product keeps beside it. The more of it the agent can read, the better it answers, so it reads freely; what keeps the data safe is that reading can't change it.

requirements.text: The agent can read the app's data, through read-only SQL or through read tools the product gives it, and nothing it reads with can change data.

history.text: The agent can run SQL on the app's SQLite database, on a connection opened read-only, so no statement it runs can change the data.
history.reason: Read-only SQL is one way to read, not the only one; a product's own read tools do as well.
